scoreGuide.heading: What the score tells you
scoreGuide.body: A single model sounds just as sure when it is right as when it is guessing. Asking several and measuring how closely they agree gives you a warning sign.

levels.high: The models say the same thing. That is a reason for more confidence, not proof.
levels.medium: They overlap but differ on details. Check the parts they disagree on.
levels.low: Stop and read the individual answers. No single answer should be trusted here.

benchmarkMethod.title: Method
benchmarkMethod.datasets: Datasets: {{list}}. Up to {{sample}} questions each, sampled with seed {{questionSeed}}.
benchmarkMethod.scoring: Multiple-choice options are shuffled with seed {{optionSeed}}. Every model gives a structured final answer, which is read and scored mechanically, with no LLM judge. Failed or timed-out calls count as wrong.
benchmarkMethod.models: Open models, each alone and together as an ensemble: {{list}}.
benchmarkMethod.reference: Premium reference, run once and cached: {{model}}.
benchmarkMethod.statistics: Accuracy has a 95% Wilson interval. Each configuration is compared with the best single open model on the same questions with a paired McNemar test (exact binomial below 25 discordant pairs).
benchmarkMethod.cost: Cost comes from the shared OpenRouter price table and the token usage each provider reported.
benchmarkMethod.docsLink: Full method and how to reproduce it
